images.caption: Figure 1:Overview ofHiVe-Mem.(a) Horizontal Memory Expansionretrieves seed episodes through summary-based semantic matching and expands to graph neighbors ranked by the specificity and query relevance of their connecting anchors.(b) Vertical Evidence Compositionuses an RL-trained selector to make binary inclusion decisions over compact summaries, image captions, grounded visual views, raw images, and raw interaction text, composing a query-dependent evidence subset for each retrieved episode to balance answer quality and token consumption.
